note: A ball on a DoubleAxisHingeJoint whose first axis is z, in zero gravity, with the motor on axis 1 set to 1 rad/s (torque limit 100): in 1.5 s the bridge turns it about 1.5 rad (hinge1Angle 1.1 to 1.9, ball above 6.3 m), staying 2 m from the pivot and within 0.1 m of the plane despite a sideways kick. X_ITE 16.6.0 keeps the 2 m radius but swings the ball about the vertical (from (2,5,0) to (0,5,2), no fall) and never raises hinge1Angle, so only the radius and its own height are checked there.
gaps: the bridge builds the hinge-2 joint (anchors meet, the axes stay at 90 degrees, a motor and limit on each); X_ITE 16.6.0 builds a plain btHingeConstraint about axis1, so axis2 does nothing there
desiredAngularVelocity1 and 2 with maxTorque1 and 2 turn the hinges in the bridge; X_ITE ignores them
suspensionForce and suspensionErrorCorrection are kept and not used
